args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though `round_money`'s docstring (and FIN-212) require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`:

- `2.665` was rounding to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`.

## Fix
Changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so half-way cases round to the nearest even cent, matching FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`.
